newsitem.title: USA: Rapist Kelly sentenced to 16 years in jail.
newsitem.headline: Rapist Kelly sentenced to 16 years in jail.

text.p: A Connecticut judge on Thursday sentenced convicted rapist Alex Kelly, who fled the country for eight years to avoid prosecution, to 16 years in jail for a rape committed 11 years ago.

Kelly, 30, was sentended to the maximum 20 years, suspended after 16 years, meaning he may not have to serve the last four years. He was convicted earlier of the February 1986 rape of Adrienne Ortolano in Darien, Connecticut, when the two were high school students and had just met at a party.
Stamford Superior Court Judge Kevin Tierney also fined Kelly $10,000 and imposed 10 years' probation with 15 special conditions.

Shortly before he was sentenced, a tearful Kelly stood and apologised to the court and his victim, Ortolano. "I never meant to hurt her...I realise now that I did hurt her. I'm sorry," he said, choking back sobs.
Kelly faces another trial on charges he raped a second high school student just four days after the rape of Ortolano.
Kelly fled the country on the eve of his originally scheduled trial in 1987, and remained an international fugitive until his 1995 surrender in Switzerland.
